received_works.body:
Hello, I really liked your work, so I would love to make a request.

I am creating a small Valentine’s visual novel featuring my character Pochita, and I would like to commission two full-body sprites, both with transparent backgrounds.
One sprite should use her casual outfit, and the other should use her maid outfit, each with a different pose.
In the Drive folder below you will find:

A reference sheet of Pochita’s design

A folder with the casual outfit and a suggested pose

A folder with the maid outfit and another suggested pose

The poses are only for inspiration, to show the general idea of what I am looking for. They do not have to be followed exactly.

Pochita’s personality is playful, teasing in a light-hearted way, but she is also affectionate and kind.

For both sprites, I need a similar variety of expressions to the ones you created in this artwork:
https://skeb.jp/@pf10ri/works/125

Please also include the following important details of her design:

Two facial beauty marks

Cat-shaped mouth with one visible fang

Pochita’s height is 156 cm

Here is the Drive link with all references:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UigauikYFW40eaLHbj1wwle9H9Qggj4T?usp=sharing

Thank you!
